notes: Selected otherEvents Hypoglycaemia as the closest registry match to the unspecified Hypoglycemia outcome. Alternative registry seriousEvents Hypoglycaemia reports 28/3494 for Linagliptin and 38/3485 for Placebo; seriousEvents Hypoglycaemic coma reports 1/3494 and 1/3485, respectively. Both held publication documents report 1036 and 1024 patients with one or more episodes of hypoglycemia (Linagliptin and placebo, respectively), but registry ownership is mandatory here. The selected otherEvents counts are not the publication all-episode counts; serious and other event counts were not combined. The outcomeMeasuresModule contains cardiovascular and renal composite outcomes, not hypoglycemia.
